_: Which Wikidata item answers for a title whose TMDB id several items claim, where no rule in
lib/wikidata.choose singles one out. lib/wikidata.resolve reads this before the rules; `item` must be
one of the claimants, and an entry for an id that is no longer contested is refused as stale.
`why` is the evidence: TMDB's own detail record (name, dates, seasons, episodes, IMDb id) against each
item's statements. `upstream` names what is wrong on Wikidata, for someone to fix there.

decisions.why: TMDB: Endless Love, released 2014-02-12, 104 min, IMDb tt2318092. Q14396397 is the 2014 film directed by Shana Feste, P577 2014-02-12, 24 sitelinks. Q109155536 is a 2014 Burmese film of the same name, P577 year-only.
decisions.upstream: Q109155536 (the Burmese film) states P4947 226857 and P345 tt2318092, both the American film's.

decisions.why: TMDB: Hornblower, first aired 1998-10-07, 3 seasons, 8 episodes. Q735749 is the series: P580 1998-10-07, P2437 3, P1113 8. Q7732641 is The Even Chance, its first television film (P179 Hornblower).
decisions.upstream: Q7732641 (The Even Chance) states P4983 814, the series' TMDB id; its own is P4947 19493.

decisions.why: TMDB: Scooby's All-Stars, first aired 1977-09-10, 2 seasons, IMDb tt0181941. Both items are that one show, with the same start, end, episode count and IMDb id. Q2601647 carries the seasons (P2437 2, P527 both seasons) and 9 sitelinks against Q922442's 4.
decisions.upstream: Q2601647 (Laff-A-Lympics) and Q922442 (Scooby's All-Star Laff-A-Lympics) are duplicate items for one series and could be merged.

decisions.upstream: Q111954103 (FLCL, season 1) states the series' P4983 5895 and P345 tt0279077.
